items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But it was Pee Wee Russell and some of the Dixieland players.

ctx.x: No, it’s not Peanuts Huckle, I know that name. He is a clarinetist. But it was Pee Wee Russell and some of the Dixieland players. Some of the guys were on staff, but they brought some guys into play that show. Jack Teegarden came through and played once– actually, a couple of times.
So, was the format of the show that you had a set rhythm section and then some leading players in that style would come in and be the guest?
